files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: In riders.csv, take each rider's surname as the last word of display_name, trimmed of spaces and written with a capital first letter and the rest lower-case. `result` should be a Series counting riders per surname, sorted from most to fewest riders, ties broken by surname alphabetically.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; surname = last word of display_name (stripped; capital first letter, rest lower case); a Series counting riders per surname, sorted by count descending, ties by surname ascending.

acceptable_variants.notes: surname may be a column of a one-column table
